title: UAPI: SET_AAD/GET_TAG/SET_TAG ioctls not dispatched — AEAD broken
description: CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_SET_AAD (slot 3), CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_GET_TAG (slot 4), and CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_SET_TAG (slot 5) are defined in crypto2dev_ioctl.h and have handler functions (ioctl_set_aad, ioctl_get_tag, ioctl_set_tag) but are NOT present in the switch statement at src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1424-1466. Every call to these ioctls returns -ENOTTY. Outcome: all AEAD (GCM) operations requiring AAD or tag management are completely unreachable from userspace. AES-GCM authenticated encryption is silently broken.
close_reason: False positive: SET_AAD/GET_TAG/SET_TAG are correctly wired in switch at fd.c:1435-1440
